entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 893550942158776832: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.5186 +/- 0.0195 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 397.04 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -0.125, -2.444 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.79 +/- 0.48 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). Mass 1.82 +/- 1.45 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). Temperature 6446 +/- 88 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 6,446 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff8fd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,446 K and log g 4.19 (u1 0.356, u2 0.312): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
